meta.name: linkedin-content-planner
meta.description: Generate a 7-day LinkedIn content plan from a theme, audience, and pillars. Produces per-day post pillar, format, hook type, CTA, posting time, daily comment targets, and a weekly inbound-readiness check. Use when the user wants to plan a week or month of content, not draft a single post (use linkedin-post-writer).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个主题排成一周七天的领英发帖计划,定好选题、形式与发布时间
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想系统安排每周的领英内容,而不是临时想今天发什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a theme into a seven-day LinkedIn posting plan with topics, formats and timings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a structured weekly LinkedIn plan instead of scrambling for post ideas

howto.what: 拿到主题、受众和支柱偏好后,它生成一份 7 天 LinkedIn 内容计划:每日的发帖支柱、格式、钩子公式、一句话角度、CTA、发布时间和每日评论目标,并附每周 inbound 就绪检查。
howto.when: 当你说「规划这一周」或「这周该发什么」,或想在发布周前对齐产品支柱时触发;它做整周/整月排期,不写单篇帖子(单篇请用 linkedin-post-writer)。

say.text: 把支柱比例改成 50% 权威 / 30% 个人故事 / 20% 社区
这周只发 3 篇,集中在周二到周四
say.note: 周计划压缩到 3 个发帖日

howto.what_en: Given a theme, audience and pillar mix, it produces a 7-day LinkedIn plan: per-day pillar, format, hook formula, one-line angle, CTA, posting time, daily comment targets, and a weekly inbound-readiness check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan your week or what to post this week, or need product-pillar alignment before a launch week; it plans a week or month, not a single post (use linkedin-post-writer).

say_en.text: Plan my LinkedIn week: theme AI agents in production, audience B2B founders
say_en.note: Returns a 7-day calendar with comment targets

say_en.text: Change the mix to 50% Authority / 30% Narrative / 20% Community
say_en.note: Re-ranks the week to that mix

say_en.text: Only 3 posts this week, Tuesday through Thursday
say_en.note: Cuts the plan to 3 posting days
